parsed.name: 点图形标注组件
parsed.description: 用于科学成像与实验数据界面的点状图形标注对象。这是一个非物理软件组件，源自 Nion Swift 图形模型，用于在图像或数据视图中表示单点标记，并支持位置管理、命中测试、拖拽编辑、微调以及基于 MIME 的序列化/复制交换，常用于交互式选点、特征标注和区域定义。
parsed.description_en: A point-style graphical annotation object for scientific imaging and experimental data interfaces. This is a non-physical software component from the Nion Swift graphics model, used to represent a single point marker in an image or data view. It supports position management, hit testing, drag editing, nudging, and MIME-based serialization or copy/transfer, commonly for interactive point selection, feature marking, and region definition.

actions.description: 获取或设置点图形的位置。
actions.description_en: Get or set the point graphic position.

actions.description: 重置点图形到默认位置。
actions.description_en: Reset the point graphic to its default position.

actions.description: 导出点图形的 MIME 数据字典，用于复制、拖放或状态交换。
actions.description_en: Export a MIME data dictionary for the point graphic for copy, drag-and-drop, or state transfer.

actions.description: 从 MIME 数据字典读取并恢复点图形状态。
actions.description_en: Read and restore the point graphic state from a MIME data dictionary.

actions.description_en: Test whether a given coordinate hits the point graphic or its label for UI interaction.

actions.description: 按给定增量微移点图形。
actions.description_en: Nudge the point graphic by a given delta.
